title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 2 to the Audit Services Bench Contract Nos. PS86611000 through PS86611007 to exercise the…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0678, Contract]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to execute Modification No. 2 to the Audit Services Bench Contract Nos. PS86611000 through PS86611007 to exercise the second, one-year option in an amount Not-To-Exceed (NTE) $2,526,140, increasing the cumulative contract value from $9,618,845 to $12,144,985 and extending the period of performance from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2027.
